cards.audioText: [Your call sign is SIA123. stand 215, from Wuhan to Singapore, information B. Request ATC clearance to Singapore.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你的呼号是新航123，215号机位，从武汉飞往新加坡，通播B，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA123, stand 215, information B, destination Singapore, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航123，215号机位，通播B，目的地新加坡，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。

cards.audioText: SIA123, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 36R, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 6325.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，武汉放行，可以按计划航路放行至新加坡，LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道36右，离场频率119.7，应答机6325。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 36R, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 6325, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至新加坡，LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道36右，离场频率119.7，应答机6325, 新航123。

cards.audioText: [You are now ready, contact Ground to request pushback and start-up.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在准备好了，联系地面，请求推出开车>]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA123, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航123，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA123, Wuhan Ground, pushback and startup approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，武汉地面，同意推出开车，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and startup approved, facing east, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，面朝东，新航123。

cards.audioText: [While taxiing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑行时，你注意到风袋显示有强烈顺风，联系塔台检查风的情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA123, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航123，证实地面风。

cards.audioText:
SIA123, surface wind 220 degrees, 8m/s.
[The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit. Contact Tower to change to runway 18L and state the reason.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航123，地面风220，8米/秒。
【该风速超过你的起飞限制。联系塔台更换至跑道18左并说明原因。】
cards.referenceText: Request runway 18L due the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于风速超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换跑道18左，新航123。

cards.audioText: SIA123, taxi to holding point runway 18L via E, D4, F.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，沿滑行道E，D4，F滑至跑道18左的等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18L via E, D4, and F. SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道E，D4，F滑至跑道18左的等待点，新航123。

cards.audioText: [After you pass taxiway E, you saw a cone lying on the taxiway D4, tell the controller what you have seen.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑过滑行道E后，你看到滑行道D4上有一个路障，告诉管制员你看到的情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA123, there is a cone lying on the taxiway D4 and it blocks my taxiway. Request assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航123，滑行道D4上有一个路障，它堵住了我的滑行道。请求援助。

cards.audioText: SIA123, roger that. Hold present position.
[You have departed from runway 18L, shortly after liftoff, you encountered a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an urgency call, request maintain runway heading.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已在跑道18左起飞，起飞后不久，飞机遭到了鸟击，右侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, SIA123, right engine failure due bird strike, request maintain runway heading.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉塔台，新航123，由于鸟击，右侧发动机失效，请求保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: [Tell the Tower you want to dump fuel and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉塔台你想放油之后返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA123 request fuel dumping and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航123，请求放油，之后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: SIA123, Tower, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO VOR 30 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，塔台，收到PANPAN，右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米，新航123。

cards.audioText: SIA123, after passing LKO, left heading 220, maintain 3000m, report over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，飞过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持，过LKO报告。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, left heading 220, maintaining 3000m, report over LKO, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持，过LKO报告，新航123。

cards.audioText: [You are over LKO, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA123, over LKO 3000m maintaining.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，新航123，过LKO，高度3000米。

cards.audioText:
SIA123, advise the time required for fuel jettison.
[Tell Wuhan Control you need approximately 25 min.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航123，报告放油需要的时间。
【告诉武汉区调你需要大约25分钟。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们需要大约25分钟，新航123。

cards.audioText: [Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉武汉进近放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道22。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA123, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，新航123，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道22。

cards.audioText: [You are now established on ILS approach runway 22, contact Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立盲降进近跑道22，联系塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA123, established ILS approach runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航123，建立盲降进近跑道22。
